description_en: Queries the statuses of multiple pipeline jobs or nodes at a time
description_zh: 批量获取工作流任务或节点的状态
kebab_example: aliyun paiflow list-pipeline-runs-status --pipeline-runs flow-hynm2bv8wqhp5esfxq --nodes PipelineRunId=flow-hynm2bv8wqhp5esfxq NodeId=node-hynm2bv8wqhp5esfx1 --workspace-id 94800 --output-type DataSet --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPipelineRunsStatus

parameters.help_en: The pipeline jobs that you want to query. You must configure PipelineRuns or Nodes. We recommend that you configure Nodes
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的工作流任务列表，PipelineRuns参数与Nodes参数两选一，优先Nodes
parameters.name: pipeline_runs

fields.help_en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the ID of the pipeline job
fields.help_zh: 工作流任务的ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
fields.name: pipeline_run_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the pipeline node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the node ID
fields.help_zh: 工作流任务节点的ID。如何获取节点ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
fields.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The nodes that you want to query. You must configure PipelineRuns or Nodes. We recommend that you configure Nodes
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的节点列表，Nodes参数与PipelineRuns参数两选一，优先Nodes
parameters.name: nodes

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The output type of the pipeline node. Valid values:

Model
DataSet
Metrics
ModelEvaluation
parameters.help_zh:
工作流任务节点产物（Artifact）的类型，取值如下：
Model：模型。
DataSet：数据集。
Metrics：度量数据。
ModelEvaluation：模型评估结果
parameters.name: output_type
